messages:
maria: Quick sync — need to lock the benchmark narrative and a 30/60/90s webinar hook by EOD. Thinking a: latency-first headline, b: cost-per-1k-tokens chart, c: routing/SLAs callout. thoughts?
aj: latency headline -> good. can we phrase it as ‘predictable latency at half the cost’? short and punchy.
sam: prefer avoid ‘half’ unless we have a clean data point. maybe ‘predictable latency with optimized unit costs’ and then call out a 2x example in the chart notes.
ellie: I'll make two sparkline options: one showing 95th P95 latency vs competitor and one cost-per-1k tokens as bars. want brand colors + grid off.
maria: yes, sam — show the conservative 2x example in a footnote. aj — still want a punchy lead line, keep your wording but swap ‘half’ -> ‘up to 2x cheaper depending on config’.
aj: works. also can we add a tiny visual callout for 'dedicated vs hosted' throughput lanes? that helps enterprise buyers.
sam: good call. we need a short sentence on routing fallbacks and canary rollouts — tech buyers care about graceful degradation.
ellie: mockups incoming in ~90 mins. will include: main hero chart (latency P95), small cost bar, and a tiny flow diagram for routing tiers.
maria: webinar plan: 20m demo (runtime, routing), 15m benchmarks & methodology (so we're transparent), 10m customer Q&A. need a short one-slide section on how we measure cost (tokens, batching, KV cache).
aj: for inbound routing, can we add a CTA variant 'See your tokens -> savings' that feeds into an eval request form? funnels to growth@ for lead scoring.
sam: ops note: when referencing benchmarks, include model versions, seq len assumptions, and hardware profile. otherwise legal will flag it.
ops-bot: deploy:benchmark-results-v2 published to /drive/bench/2955 — access: @marketing, @growth, @product.
maria: perfect. one last thing — messaging tone: marketing wants clarity, product wants nuance. propose we have two copy variants for the page: TL;DR (consumer-friendly) and TECH (expandable panel with all assumptions). small AB test on CTA colors.
aj: agree. i'll wire up the inbound form and scoring rules.
ellie: uploading first PNGs now: https://figma.com/file/abc123/bench-webinar - please check visuals and leave comments.
sam: i'll draft the methodology slide and the one-liner for routing. ping me for numbers to avoid absolute claims.
maria: thanks team — if no objections i'll push draft to staging and share with sales by 17:30. :thumbsup:
